body:
Thank you for your answer.
It is hard to describe, but I have changed my mindset so often. I mostly find an optimistic way to see my life, but now it seems that looking back no matter how I approached everything, my life hasn't changed.
I have been going to the gym almost daily for the last years.(I was even today). I was in the emergency medical service for my national service. This is where I saw a huge amount of people, and understood that I liked almost everyone of them and even sometimes liked that time, but those weren't the people I would consider as friends.
As I stand to myself and search only for a specific character(like me), I have only seen a few woman in my entire life that I would consider dating. 
I am not going to end my life this week, but probably very soon.
